tickets.empty_state_desc: Open your first ticket to get started.
tickets.new_field_department_hint: Which department to send the request to — not your own.
tickets.chat_busy_desc: Everyone is helping other people. Join the queue and you will be served as soon as possible.
tickets.chat_offline_desc: Leave us a message and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
tickets.btn_open_ticket_instead: I would rather open a ticket
tickets.chat_new_intro: Hi! Tell us how we can help — an agent will reply right here.
tickets.chat_connection_failed: No real-time connection. Reopen the widget to try again.
tickets.chat_offline_fallback: Our agents became unavailable. Leave your message here and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
tickets.error_identity: We couldn't verify your identity. Reload the page; if it keeps happening, contact the system's support.
tickets.chat_bot_hint: You are chatting with a virtual assistant.
tickets.chat_handoff_requested: Request sent: a person will take over the conversation.
tickets.chat_handoff_error: We could not reach a person right now. Please try again.
tickets.chat_handoff_text: I want to talk to a human agent.
tickets.chat_new_intro_bot: Hi! I am the virtual assistant and I answer right away. If you prefer, ask for a person at any time.
tickets.chat_new_intro_bot_named: Hi! I am {name}, the virtual assistant, and I answer right away. If you prefer, ask for a person at any time.
tickets.chat_online_desc_bot: Our virtual assistant answers right away, 24/7. You can ask for a person whenever you want.
tickets.csat_error_timeout: Your rating was not sent: the server took too long to respond. Check your connection and try again.
tickets.csat_error_network: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
tickets.csat_error_generic: We could not send your rating right now. Please try again.
tickets.csat_not_resolved: Your ticket is still in progress. You will be able to rate the service once it is resolved.
tickets.chat_followup_notice: Your request continues in ticket {n}. You will get the answer here and by email.
tickets.detail_chat_error: Could not load the chat conversation.
tickets.detail_reopen_hint: If the problem comes back, reply here — the ticket will be reopened (until {date}).
tickets.detail_reopen_hint_nodate: If the problem comes back, reply here — the ticket will be reopened.
tickets.detail_closed_notice: This ticket has been closed. If you need to, start a new conversation or ticket — it will be linked to this one.
tickets.splash_title: Before you continue — see what changed
tickets.splash_count_one: 1 update waiting for you. Mark it as read to continue.
tickets.splash_count_many: {n} updates waiting. Mark each one as read or skip for now.
tickets.splash_skip: Skip for now — I’ll remind you next time you open the widget

releaseNotes.scrollHint: Scroll to the end to enable confirmation
releaseNotes.ackButton: I have read and acknowledge the new features and changes
releaseNotes.ackError: Couldn't save your confirmation. Check your connection and try again.
